The '''Rigel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rigel VII]].
